properties.notes: Any future development proposals should consider that the site is within the Green Belt. Green Belt policies will apply to any future development proposals.. Redevelopment of site to provide 34 new residential units (class C3), set out in 4 blocks of accommodation, comprising 6x1 bed and 28x2 bed apartments, together with associated car parking and access, private and shared amenity space, landscaping and other ancillary works.
